main.description: Get an actor's profile. Returns full detail — including dashboard entitlements — only for the authenticated caller; for any other actor it returns public basics only.

actor.description: Handle or DID to look up. Defaults to the authenticated caller.

isSelf.description: Whether this profile is the authenticated caller's. When false, the entitlement fields are absent — they are never populated for another actor.

isMember.description: Caller only. Whether the actor may use the dashboard.

isCustomer.description: Caller only. Whether the actor is a member of the customers space, the same rule the customer endpoints apply.

access.description: Caller only. Access level in the HappyProto admin space.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: Declared for the customer gate the script consults; getProfile never returns it, since a refused gate reports isCustomer false.

errors.name: ActorNotFound
errors.description: The requested actor could not be resolved.
